name: Vault Path Portability
changes: The Vault Path Portability notice for a Pro feature now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Select Copy Markdown to put the whole report on the clipboard. Paste it into a note to use as a checklist for your move.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Vault Path Portability is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your vault portable.

related.name: Vault Loss Alarm
related.blurb: Warn you when notes or attachments vanish from your vault, with the last known size of each path.

related.name: Sync Churn Watch
related.blurb: Find the files and settings that your vault rewrites most often.
